name: Education & Learning TRIZ
description: Same TRIZ machinery with education / learning vocabulary — students, curricula, assessment, engagement, retention and attention.

parameter_map.Loss of information: knowledge decay / what students forget / missed explanations
parameter_map.Speed: pace of instruction / time to mastery
parameter_map.Quantity of substance: class size / content volume / seat hours
parameter_map.Reliability: consistency of learning outcomes across cohorts

principle_soft.1: segment the curriculum into small modules / micro-lessons
principle_soft.2: take the explanation out of the live lecture — flipped classroom, video on demand
principle_soft.3: local quality — per-student pacing and adaptive difficulty per topic
principle_soft.5: combine modalities — lecture + practice + peer discussion
principle_soft.10: pre-load prerequisites and pre-teach vocabulary before the lesson
principle_soft.15: dynamic assessment — adaptive tests that shift difficulty in real time
principle_soft.19: spaced repetition at regular intervals to beat the forgetting curve
principle_soft.25: self-service learning — self-graded drills with automatic feedback

examples: Students must retain more of the lesson, but adding review time leaves no room for new content.
The course must scale to more students, but personalized feedback requires more teacher time.
The assessment must measure real understanding, but longer exams exhaust the students.
